name: infographic-docs
description: Multi-page HTML explainer/guide generator. Builds styled, multi-tab HTML docs into the knowledge-base, creates last-30-days community pulse docs, routes optional external tools, previews through Playwright MCP, renders diagrams/charts, and registers docs in the library index.

interface.shortDescription: HTML explainers plus last-30-days community pulse docs
interface.longDescription: Generates folder-based HTML explainers and last-30-days community pulse reports in the Codex/Obsidian style guide, saved into ${KB_ROOT}/info-docs and registered in the root library index. Community pulse docs synthesize what people are saying across Reddit, X/Twitter, GitHub, Hacker News, YouTube, blogs, and news. It can route optional external helpers for shadcn app-mode work, Playwright MCP previews, Mermaid diagrams, Vega-Lite charts, and Tool Finder update tracking.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this as a multi-page HTML doc
